svg.title: libmuffintin
svg.desc: libmuffintin. Unchanged complete tray, side-wall bands, cups, sphere grids, connecting curves, copper loop handle and outlined Quicksand Bold wordmark. The lower-right copper emblem is an independent foreground layer, using the original reference Bezier faces and exact alignment-overlay transform. Its navy outline is localized and clipped to the source silhouette. Copper faces and thickness faces have no added stroke or extrusion.
